# where size = total_input_len - 4

# 3. Has olimit positioned such that the check passes but write overflows

# - but op + 4*floor((matchCode-15)/1020) + 3 >= olimit (write overflows)

# Write overflow: 7 + 4*floor(199965/1020) + 3 >= dstCapacity
#                 7 + 4*196 + 3 = 7 + 784 + 3 = 794 >= dstCapacity

# So dstCapacity ≈ 794 should be the boundary!
